scripts.// dev: Levanta todos los servicios en modo development con nodemon
scripts.// dev:auth: Levanta auth + users + mongo en modo development
scripts.dev:auth: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build auth-service users-service mongo
scripts.// dev:passwords: Levanta passwords + auth + users + mongo en modo development
scripts.dev:passwords: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build passwords-service auth-service users-service mongo
scripts.// dev:gateway: Levanta solo el gateway en modo development
scripts.dev:gateway: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build api-gateway
scripts.// dev:python: Levanta python-service + gateway en modo development
scripts.dev:python: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build python-service api-gateway
